thread:
Alex (PM): Quick thread to lock down the next DP cohort invite cadence + failsafe protocol. want a simple, repeatable playbook we can reuse.
Sam (Product Ops): love that. propose 30 invites -> target 18 engaged. keep a standby list of 12 in case of last-minute dropouts.
Lina (Research): for signal collection: each partner receives 6 core tasks, plus an open feedback session. we need standardized post-session survey.
Maya (Design): onboarding checklist: 1) access keys + quickstart, 2) canonical prompt set, 3) reporting template. I'll sketch templates. :page_facing_up:
Omar (Eng): infra ask: we should reserve a "dp-onboard" pool with 6 concurrent slots and burst to 10. prefer a dedicated small shard during onboarding weeks.
Alex (PM): staging plan idea: invite waves — wave A (10) -> wave B (10) -> wave C (10). run wave A for 72h smoke, wave B for 72h, then ramp C. hold if any fail-safes trigger.
Lina (Research): metrics for hold/rollback: 1) automated eval regression >12% on core prompts, 2) >4 P1 customer-impact incidents in 24h, 3) >20% of sessions with broken structured outputs.
Omar (Eng): can we separate "hold" vs "rollback"? hold = pause ramp and investigate; rollback = revert to previous model. I suggest: hold if any single metric breaches; rollback if 2+ metrics breach or P1 incidents escalate.
Sam (Product Ops): comms plan: pre-written lines for "we hit a snag" + FAQ. also a transparent incident feed for partners. Maya can own partner-facing messaging.
Maya (Design): I'll draft a 3-paragraph partner note and a quick troubleshooting guide. will include a snippet:```text
If you see output formatting issues, please copy the id and paste into this form: https://redwood.zendesk/dp-issues
```
DeployBot: Canary policy created: 10% -> 40% -> 100% with auto-hold thresholds wired to metrics: latency p95, error-rate, custom-eval delta.
Alex (PM): decision on quality thresholds: Lina, can you finalize numeric thresholds and the smoke script by Friday?
Lina (Research): yes. I'll produce an eval bundle (10 seed prompts + 30 variations) + the survey and pass/fail rubric by Fri EOD.
Omar (Eng): I'll add infra runbook entries and the reserve command:```bash
redwood infra reserve --pool dp-onboard --gpus 6 --burst 10 --until 2024-12-01
```
Sam (Product Ops): onboarding timeline draft: week 0 outreach, week 1 cohort screening, week 2 onboarding batch A, week 4 full rollout. cadence doc in #dp-onboarding.
Alex (PM): point people during canary: Omar = infra triage, Maya = partner comms, Lina = quality lead, Sam = logistics. I'll be backup PM.
Maya (Design): noted. I'll prep the partner note + FAQ.
Lina (Research): adding a short smoke check that runs every 30m during canary: run 6 evals, compare delta, surface to dashboard.
Omar (Eng): monitoring hooks: export eval-delta metric, p95 latency, error-rate, and a "structured-output-fail" counter. wire alerts to #dp-canary and on-call.
Alex (PM): final ask: Sam, can you own invite CSV + consent flow? also add a quick opt-out clause in the email.
Sam (Product Ops): yes. will share CSV by Thu and a draft invite email.
DeployBot: Calendar event created: "DP Cohort Invite + Failsafe Kickoff" Mon 09:00 PT.
Alex (PM): Great. I'll follow up with a short kickoff doc and assign tasks in Asana. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Maya (Design): :white_check_mark:
Lina (Research): 👍
Omar (Eng): ack.
